notes.title: FireTry Capture The Flag dlc is being removed from the store
notes.content:
FireTry Capture The Flag dlc is being removed from the store.
But players who have previously purchased this dlc will still be able to continue playing and downloading this dlc.
The reason we took this dlc remove, we realized that it breaks the structure of the main game and reduces the fun.
We will always be working to provide better content to our valuable players.

notes.title: New dlc has been released.
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285300/FireTry_Capture_The_Flag][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35460052/2e283ac46e5ea54868cbc3f4336c5d51954b9151.jpg[/img][/url]

FireTry: Capture The Flag invites you for fun.
With this dlc, you can play flag grabbing mode with bots or with your friends.
You can play the default levels that come with Dlc, or you can design your own 
capture the flag levels.

notes.title: New dlc for FireTry has been released.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35460052/76098a2300ec26d7e0ee7898f20681d0815b8ccd.jpg[/img]

With the cars package, 15 new cars were added to FireTry.
In addition, 21 levels specific to this package are offered to you as a gift.
You can play coop with your friends, good games for everyone.
